body:
## What to build

An ordinary across naming expression that raises an External condition must propagate that failure with its class, diagnostic, and cause intact. Output-name prediction must not consume a caller error and retry until the call succeeds.

A naming callback in the reproduction fails on its first invocation and returns a valid name on later invocations. The local Margin call without a share fails after one read. Adding a Total share makes the same ordinary expression run three times and turns the call into success. Lazy dtplyr and simulated SQL paths also retry and succeed without a share; live DuckDB native construction reproduced the same gap. Direct dplyr controls fail after one invocation.

This extends the failed-evaluation path beyond the successful-callback count case repaired by #684. It is an External condition preservation problem, separate from the selector-context failure recorded as F4.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] F3 propagates the original custom naming error rather than returning total 3 and share 1.
- [ ] Adding a share preserves the ordinary naming failure, callback evaluation count, custom condition class, and cause.
- [ ] Cover both a transient first-invocation error and a persistent error on local share-aware planning and supported lazy construction paths. Compare with the owning backend's ordinary dplyr behavior.
- [ ] Successful dynamic names remain evaluated in their proper context without extra prediction-time invocations; preserve #684's protections and actual-output collision validation.
- [ ] Follow the External condition and Condition context contracts, add focused public regressions, and pass the Review-ready check.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[F3 investigation, controls, and measured error loss](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/59b6eb2ef27ccbff0b283c5a19331c170c0be620/investigation/2026-10-26-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/README.md#f3-a-failed-names-expression-disappeared-on-retry). The linked public replay fails independently on the pinned main commit. No implementation is included.
title: [P2] Preserve an across naming error instead of retrying it away
